verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any developer-facing API. Its internal use of AI-based legaltech and its Prarambh incubator are not APIs offered to users, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
